svg.title: Figure 4-4. Scene cards: the unsafe control actions of the panda safety model (C3) (WP-A-05 §4)
svg.desc: One card per UCA of the panda safety model (C3): UCA-30 The panda passes torque the driver cannot counter; UCA-31 The panda keeps authority while the driver brakes; UCA-32 The panda keeps authority after openpilot has stalled; UCA-33 The panda stays in intercept while stock PCS is not forwarded; UCA-34 The panda transmits while stock steering still gets through; UCA-35 The panda drops authority at once, and only the SoC says so; UCA-36 The item stays engaged while the stock PCS path is cut.
svg.text: Figure 4-4. Scene cards: the unsafe control actions of the panda safety model (C3)

Each card: the UCA type; a road scene (schematic, loops every 6 s); when the control action is needed against what happens; what the controller believes; its control loop with the broken link in red; the loss scenarios and their status.
UCA text and types from WP-A-05 §4, statuses, decisions and requirements from stpa-map.yaml. Scenes and charts explain the scenarios; they are not simulation or test results.

g.title: UCA-30: The panda passes torque the driver cannot counter
g.text: UCA-30 · PANDA SAFETY MODEL (C3) · TYPE P, PROVIDED
The panda passes torque the driver
H-01 unintended steering · H-03 unintended acceleration · H-04 unintended braking
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Wrong plan: full torque, full rate
The car darts into the next lane
NEEDED WINDOW · HOW MUCH TORQUE MAY PASS
The envelope still equals the controller limits: torque 1500,
rate 15/25, error 350; −3.5 m/s² both sides. A wrong plan at
full torque and rate passes unchanged.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED
LS-11 · known gap · inadequate control algorithm

g.title: UCA-32: The panda keeps authority after openpilot has stalled
g.text: UCA-32 · PANDA SAFETY MODEL (C3) · TYPE D, WRONG DURATION
H-01 unintended steering · H-02 silent loss of steering
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S

svg.text: without the arrival check: heartbeat still
arrives, so the stale command runs on

g.text: controlsd stalls at the curve entry
SoC alert; the driver steers the curve

svg.text: No panda siren for this case: the alert comes from the SoC

g.text: NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN AUTHORITY MAY STAND
“Heartbeats keep coming, so openpilot is alive
controlsd has stalled. card repeats the last command for about
0.1 s, then the frames stop. The heartbeat comes from pandad,
which still runs. The TX-arrival check ends authority 50 ms
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED, SAFETY NET IN GREEN

g.title: UCA-34: The panda transmits while stock steering still gets through
g.text: UCA-34 · PANDA SAFETY MODEL (C3) · TYPE N, NOT PROVIDED
H-01 unintended steering · H-04 unintended braking

A switch is stuck in pass-through
Stock and item commands both reach the car
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN AUTHORITY MAY STAND
“The switches are in intercept; only my frames
A switch stuck in pass-through (or SBU1 lost, R2/R3 shorted)
lets the camera's 0x2E4 and 0x343 reach the car with the
item's. The stock-ECU check sees them only after the 1 s

g.title: UCA-35: The panda drops authority at once, and only the SoC says so
g.text: UCA-35 · PANDA SAFETY MODEL (C3) · TYPE D, WRONG DURATION
The panda drops authority at once, and
H-02 silent loss of steering · H-06 silent loss of braking · H-07 mode confusion
FOUR WAYS A CONTROL ACTION GOES WRONG
ROAD SCENE · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Panda watchdog reset in the curve
Authority gone; SoC alert within 0.5 s
No siren: the reset cleared what it needs
NEEDED WINDOW · WHEN THE DRIVER MUST BE WARNED
“I've just booted; nothing is engaged, so
there is nothing to warn about.”
A watchdog reset drops authority at once. The MCU boots
SILENT, and every siren source needs controls_allowed or a
counter the reset cleared. Only the SoC alerts, within 0.5 s.
CONTROL LOOP · BROKEN LINK IN RED, SAFETY NET IN GREEN
